label: Average disposable income per capita
definition: Ratio between the total disposable income of consumers households and the total number of resident people (in current euros).

label: Average annual salary of employees
definition: Ratio between the total annual gross salary of employees of the private sector (excluding agriculture) and the number of employees insured with the National Social Security Institute (in euros).

label: Average annual per capita amount of pension income
definition: Ratio between the total amount of pensions paid in the year (in euros) and the number of pensioners.

label: Pensioners with a low pension income
definition: Percentage of pensionners receiving a gross monthly pension income of less than 500 euros out of total pensionners.

label: Bad loan entry rate of bank loans to households
definition: Percentage ratio between the amounts of new bad debts in the year (loans to subjects declared insolvent or difficult to recover during the year) and the stock of non-bad loans in the year.

label: Participation in the school system of children aged 4-5
definition: Percentage of children aged 4-5 years participating in pre-primary education or in primary education on total children aged 4-5 years

label: People with at least upper secondary education level (25-64 years old)
definition: Percentage of people aged 25-64 years having completed at least upper secondary education (ISCED level not below 3) on total people aged 25-64 years.

label: People having completed tertiary education (ISCED 5, 6, 7 or 8)
definition: Percentage of people aged 25-39 years having completed tertiary education (ISCED 5, 6, 7 or 8) on total people aged 25-39 years.

label: First-time entry rate to university by cohort of upper secondary graduates
definition: Proportion of new-graduates from upper secondary education enrolled for the first time at university in the same year of upper secondary graduation (cohort-specific rate). Students enrolled in "Istituti Tecnici Superiori", "Istituti di Alta Formazione Artistica, Musicale e Coreutica", "Scuole superiori per Mediatori linguistici" and at foreign universities are excluded.
source: Ministry of Education; Ministry of University and Research

label: People not in education, employment, or training (NEET)
definition: Percentage of people aged 15-29 years that are not in education, employment, or training on total people aged 15-29 years

label: Participation in life-long learning
definition: Percentage of people aged 25-64 years participating in formal or non-formal education on total people aged 25-64 years

label: Inadequate level of numeracy (students in grade 8)
definition: Share of students in grade 8 (third year of lower secondary education) who do not reach an adequate level of proficiency in numerical competence (level 2 out of 5 levels)

label: Inadequate level of literacy (students in grade 8)
definition: Share of students in grade 8 (third year of lower secondary education) who do not reach an adequate level of proficiency in literacy competence (level 2 out of 5 levels)

label: Children who benefited of early childhood services
definition: Percentage of users on the target population of the service(children 0-2 years old)

label: PM10 Annual average concentration
definition: Higher value of the annual average concentration of PM10 detected among all fixed air quality monitoring units in provincial capital municipalities. Values at NUTS2, NUTS1 and national level indicate the number of capital municipalities with a value higher than the limit fixed by the World Health Organization (WHO) for the protection of human health (20 µg/m³).

label: PM2.5 Annual average concentration
definition: Higher value of the annual average concentration of PM2.5 detected among all fixed air quality monitoring units in provincial capital municipalities. Values at NUTS2, NUTS1 and national level indicate the number of capital municipalities with a value higher than the limit fixed by the World Health Organization (WHO) for the protection of human health (10 µg/m³).

label: Water losses in urban supply system
definition: Percentage of the total volume of water losses in municipal drinking water supply networks (difference between volumes fed into the network and supplied authorised volumes) on total water input.

label: Urban green
definition: Square meters of urban parks and gardens per inhabitants in provincial capital Municipalities.

label: Population at risk of landslides
definition: Percentage of population resident in areas subject to high and very high landslide hazard, identified on the basis of the ISPRA National Mosaicature of the Hydrogeological Planning Plans (PAI) and its updates. The population considered is that of the 2011 Census.

label: Population at risk of flood
definition: Percentage of population resident in medium flood hazard zones (Return period 100-200 years; D. Lgs. 49/2010), identified on the basis of the ISPRA National Mosaicature of the Hydrogeological Planning Plans (PAI) and its updates, with reference to risk scenario P2. The population considered is that of the 2011 Census.

label: Protected natural areas
definition: Percentage share of terrestrial protected natural areas included in Italian Official List of Protected Areas (Euap) and Natura 2000 Network.

label: Electricity from renewable sources
definition: Percentage of energy consumption provided by renewable sources on gross electricity consumption. The indicator is calculated as the ratio between the gross electricity production from RES (actual, non-normalized) and the gross domestic consumption of electricity (e.g. the gross production of electricity, including pumping, plus trade balance).

label: Separate collection of municipal waste
definition: Percentage of municipal waste object of separate collection on total municipal waste

label: Soil sealing from artificial land cover
definition: Percentage of soil sealed following a change from non-artificial to artificial coverage.

label: Municipal waste generated
definition: Municipal waste generated per capita (in Kg)

label: Life expectancy at birth
definition: Life expectancy expresses the average number of years that a child born in a given calendar year can expect to live if exposed during his whole life to the risks of death observed in the same year at different ages

label: Infant mortality rate
definition: Deaths during the first year of life per 10.000 born alive.

label: Road accidents mortality rate (15-34 years old)
definition: Mortality rate in road accidents by five year age groups for people aged 15-34 years, standardised by the European 2013 population of the same age groups.

label: Age-standardised cancer mortality rate (20-64 years old)
definition: Mortality rate for cancer (initial cause) by five year age groups for people aged 20-64 years, standardised by the European 2013population in the same age groups.

label: Age-standardised mortality rate for dementia and nervous system diseases (65 years and over)
definition: Mortality rate for nervous system diseases and psychical and behavioural disorders (initial cause) by five year age groups for people aged 65 years and over, standardised by the European 2013population in the same age groups.

label: Avoidable mortality (age 0-74)
definition: Deaths of persons aged 0-74, due to causes identified as treatable (in the light of medical knowledge and technology at the time of death, most deaths from that cause could be avoided through optimal quality health care) or preventable (in the light of understanding of the determinants of health at the time of death, most deaths from that cause could be avoided by public health interventions in the broadest sense). The definition of the lists of treatable and preventable causes of mortality is based on a joint OECD/Eurostat work, revised in November 2019. Standardised rates with European 2013 population aged 0-74, per 10,000 residents.

label: Patent propensity
definition: Number of patent applications filed to the European Patent Office (EPO) per million of inhabitants.

label: Employed in local units of cultural entreprises
definition: Percentage of employees in local business units active in a sector of "totally" cultural economic activity out of the total number of employees in local business units, according to the Eurostat definition of "totally" cultural economic activity.

label: Municipalities with online services for families
definition: Percentage of Municipalities that provide online at least one service for families or individuals at a level that allows the electronic start and conclusion of the entire process (including any online payment).

label: Brain circulation (Italians, 25-39 years old)
definition: Net migration rate of Italians aged 25-39, holders of a tertiary degree: (immigrants-emigrants/ total resident population * 1,000). Both numerator and denominator refer to Italians holders of a tertiary degree, aged 25-39. Values for Italy refer only to migration movements to and from abroad, since net internal migration is zero. At the subnational level, the rate also includes internal migration.

label: Density and importance of musems' heritage
definition: Number of permanent exhibition facilities per 100 sq.km (museums, archaeological sites, and monuments open to public), weighed by the number of visitors. The weight of each facility is equal to Vi / (V/M), where Vi is the number of visitors to the facility, M is the total number of facilities and V is the total number of visitors.

label: Spread of agritourism farms
definition: Number of farmhouses per 100 sq.km

label: Density of Historic Parks/Gardens
definition: Surface area in m2 of parks and gardens declared historic and/or of a significant public interest under Legislative Decree no. 42/2004 in the provincial capital Municipalities, per 100 m2 of urban area (inhabited Census areas surveyed in 2021).

label: Voter turnout
definition: Percentage of eligible voter who cast a ballot in the last election for the European Parliament (excluding voting abroad).

label: Voter turnout (Regional Councils)
definition: Percentage of eligible voters who cast a ballot in the last election for the Italian Regional Councils.

label: Women municipal councilors
definition: Percentage of women out of the total number of elected municipal administrators.

label: Municipal councilors under the age of 40
definition: Percentage of councilors with less than 40 years out of the total number of elected municipal administrators.

label: Provincial governments and Metropolitan Cities collection capacity
definition: Percentage ratio between the amount of the accruals collections and the ascertained revenue.

label: Municipalities collection capacity
definition: Percentage ratio between the amount of the accruals collections and the ascertained revenue.

label: Prison density
definition: Percentage of prisoners in penal institutions on the total capacity of penal institutions (excluding non-functioning institutions).

label: Medical specialists
definition: Practicing medical specialists (excluding general pratictioners and pediatricians) working in the public and private healthcare system per 10,000 inhabitants.

label: Hospital beds
definition: Beds (inpatient, day hospital and day surgery care)  in public and private hospitals per 10,000 inhabitants.

label: Irregularities in electric power distribution
definition: Frequency of accidental long lasting electric power cuts (cuts without notice longer than 3 minutes) (average number per consumer).

label: Seat-Km of public transport networks
definition: Seat-Km of public transport networks per capita in provincial capital Municipalities.

label: Overall Fixed Very High Capacity Network (VHCN) coverage
definition: Percentage of households which are resident in an area served by a very high capacity network (FTTH).

label: Hospital beds in high-care wards
definition: Hospital beds in high care wards in ordinary inpatient care in public and private health care institutions per 10,000 inhabitants. The following wards are included: paediatric cardiac surgery, cardiac surgery, infectious diseases, spinal unit, neurosurgery, psychiatry, nephrology, haemodialysis, neonatology, paediatric neurosurgery.

label: Separate collection service for municipal waste
definition: Percentage of resident population in municipalities with separate collection greater than or equal to 65%.

label: Hospital patient emigration to a different region
definition: Percentage of hospital discharges carried out in regions other than that of residence on the total discharges of residents in the region. Data refer only to inpatient discharges for "acute" care (excluding hospitalizations of "spinal unit", "functional rehabilitation", "neuro-rehabilitation", "long-term care").

label: Intentional homicide rate
definition: Number of intentional homicides on total population per 100.000

label: Burglaries reported
definition: Number of burglaries reported on total population per 100,000

label: Pick-pocketings reported
definition: Number of pick-pocketings reported on total population per 100,000

label: Robberies reported
definition: Number of robberies reported on total population per 100,000

label: Deadly crimes reported
definition: Number of murders (excluding intentional murders), massacre, infanticide reported on the total population per 100.000

label: Road mortality in non-urban roads
definition: Killed in road accidents in non-urban roads out of the total of road accidents in non-urban roads

label: Schools without architectural barriers
definition:
Percentage of school buildings without architectural barriers on the total of school buildings. These are only the schools which have all the characteristics in accordance with the law (lifts, bathrooms, doors, stairs) and which, if necessary, have external ramps and / or stairlifts. Barriers for people with sensory disabilities are not taken into account.The survey refers to Early childhood education, Primary education, Lower secondary education and Upper secondary education (state or not).
The indicator may be affected by variations of response rate of each items. Furthermore, in the 2022-2023 the methodology for calculating the indicator was changed

label: Nonprofit organizations
definition: Number of no-profit organizations per 10,000 inhabitants

label: Employment rate (20-64 years old)
definition: Percentage of employed people aged 20-64 on total population aged 20-64

label: Non-participation rate
definition: Percentage of unemployed people and the potential labour force (those who have not looked for a job in the past 4 weeks but willing to work), on the total labour force (employed and unemployed) plus the potential labour force, referred to population aged 15-74.

label: Youth's employment rate (15-29 years old)
definition: Percentage of employed people aged 20-64 on total people aged 20-64

label: Paid days in the year (employees)
definition: Percentage ratio between the average number of days actually paid in the year to an employee insured with the National Social Security Institute and the theoretical number of days paid in a year to a full-time employee (312 days)

label: Youth's non-participation rate
definition: Percentage of unemployed people aged 15-29 plus part of the potential labour force aged 15-29 who are inactive not having looked for a job in the past 4 weeks but willing to work, on the total labour force aged 15-29 plus part of the potential labour force aged 15-29 who are inactive not having looked for a job in the past 4 weeks but willing to work.

label: Rate of fatal occupational injuries or injuries leading to permanent disability
definition: Number of fatal occupational injuries and injuries leading to permanent disability OUT OF total employed people (excluding the armed forces) per 10,000.
